verses.text: Therefore you have no excuse, everyone of you who passes judgment, for in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself; for you who judge practice the same things.
verses.textZh: 你這論斷人的，無論你是誰，也無可推諉。你在甚麼事上論斷人，就在甚麼事上定自己的罪；因你這論斷人的，自己所行卻和別人一樣。

verses.text: And we know that the judgment of God rightly falls upon those who practice such things.
verses.textZh: 我們知道這樣行的人，神必照真理審判他。

verses.text: But do you suppose this, O man, when you pass judgment on those who practice such things and do the same [yourself], that you will escape the judgment of God?
verses.textZh: 你這人哪，你論斷行這樣事的人，自己所行的卻和別人一樣，你以為能逃脫神的審判麼？

verses.text: Or do you think lightly of the riches of His kindness and tolerance and patience, not knowing that the kindness of God leads you to repentance?
verses.textZh: 還是你藐視他豐富的恩慈、寬容、忍耐，不曉得他的恩慈是領你悔改呢？

verses.text: But because of your stubbornness and unrepentant heart you are storing up wrath for yourself in the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God,
verses.textZh: 你竟任著你剛硬不悔改的心，為自己積蓄忿怒，以致神震怒，顯他公義審判的日子來到。

verses.text: who WILL RENDER TO EACH PERSON ACCORDING TO HIS DEEDS:
verses.textZh: 他必照各人的行為報應各人。

verses.text: to those who by perseverance in doing good seek for glory and honor and immortality, eternal life;
verses.textZh: 凡恆心行善、尋求榮耀、尊貴，和不能朽壞之福的，就以永生報應他們；

verses.text: but to those who are selfishly ambitious and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, wrath and indignation.
verses.textZh: 惟有結黨、不順從真理、反順從不義的，就以忿怒、惱恨報應他們。

verses.text: [There will be] tribulation and distress for every soul of man who does evil, of the Jew first and also of the Greek,
verses.textZh: 將患難、困苦加給一切作惡的人，先是猶太人，後是希利尼人；

verses.text: but glory and honor and peace to everyone who does good, to the Jew first and also to the Greek.
verses.textZh: 卻將榮耀、尊貴、平安加給一切行善的人，先是猶太人，後是希利尼人。

verses.text: For there is no partiality with God.
verses.textZh: 因為神不偏待人。

verses.text: For all who have sinned without the Law will also perish without the Law, and all who have sinned under the Law will be judged by the Law;
verses.textZh: 凡沒有律法犯了罪的，也必不按律法滅亡；凡在律法以下犯了罪的，也必按律法受審判。

verses.text: for [it is] not the hearers of the Law [who] are just before God, but the doers of the Law will be justified.
verses.textZh: （原來在神面前，不是聽律法的為義，乃是行律法的稱義。

verses.text: For when Gentiles who do not have the Law do instinctively the things of the Law, these, not having the Law, are a law to themselves,
verses.textZh: 沒有律法的外邦人若順著本性行律法上的事，他們雖然沒有律法，自己就是自己的律法。

verses.text: in that they show the work of the Law written in their hearts, their conscience bearing witness and their thoughts alternately accusing or else defending them,
verses.textZh: 這是顯出律法的功用刻在他們心裡，他們是非之心同作見證，並且他們的思念互相較量，或以為是，或以為非。）

verses.text: on the day when, according to my gospel, God will judge the secrets of men through Christ Jesus.
verses.textZh: 就在神藉耶穌基督審判人隱祕事的日子，照著我的福音所言。

verses.text: But if you bear the name 'Jew ' and rely upon the Law and boast in God,
verses.textZh: 你稱為猶太人，又倚靠律法，且指著神誇口；

verses.text: and know [His] will and approve the things that are essential, being instructed out of the Law,
verses.textZh: 既從律法中受了教訓，就曉得神的旨意，也能分別是非（或作：也喜愛那美好的事）；

verses.text: and are confident that you yourself are a guide to the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,
verses.textZh: 又深信自己是給瞎子領路的，是黑暗中人的光，

verses.text: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of the immature, having in the Law the embodiment of knowledge and of the truth,
verses.textZh: 是蠢笨人的師傅，是小孩子的先生，在律法上有知識和真理的模範。

verses.text: you, therefore, who teach another, do you not teach yourself? You who preach that one shall not steal, do you steal?
verses.textZh: 你既是教導別人，還不教導自己麼？你講說人不可偷竊，自己還偷竊麼？

verses.text: You who say that one should not commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
verses.textZh: 你說人不可姦淫，自己還姦淫麼？你厭惡偶像，自己還偷竊廟中之物麼？

verses.text: You who boast in the Law, through your breaking the Law, do you dishonor God?
verses.textZh: 你指著律法誇口，自己倒犯律法，玷辱神麼？

verses.text: For 'THE NAME OF GOD IS BLASPHEMED AMONG THE GENTILES BECAUSE OF YOU,' just as it is written.
verses.textZh: 神的名在外邦人中，因你們受了褻瀆，正如經上所記的。

verses.text: For indeed circumcision is of value if you practice the Law; but if you are a transgressor of the Law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
verses.textZh: 你若是行律法的，割禮固然於你有益；若是犯律法的，你的割禮就算不得割禮。

verses.text: So if the uncircumcised man keeps the requirements of the Law, will not his uncircumcision be regarded as circumcision?
verses.textZh: 所以那未受割禮的，若遵守律法的條例，他雖然未受割禮，豈不算是有割禮麼？

verses.text: And he who is physically uncircumcised, if he keeps the Law, will he not judge you who though having the letter [of the Law] and circumcision are a transgressor of the Law?
verses.textZh: 而且那本來未受割禮的，若能全守律法，豈不是要審判你這有儀文和割禮竟犯律法的人麼？

verses.text: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, nor is circumcision that which is outward in the flesh.
verses.textZh: 因為外面作猶太人的，不是真猶太人；外面肉身的割禮，也不是真割禮。

verses.text: But he is a Jew who is one inwardly; and circumcision is that which is of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the letter; and his praise is not from men, but from God.
verses.textZh: 惟有裡面作的，才是真猶太人；真割禮也是心裡的，在乎靈，不在乎儀文。這人的稱讚不是從人來的，乃是從神來的。
